results.title: Outsider play_match with 50 Tgas (exploiter vs tft-oneshot)
results.expected: refused for too little gas, or the match is played normally (never voided by an outsider)
results.actual: tx ok; OutLayer receipts FAILED (Exceeded the prepaid gas.); match now void (callback_failed)
results.finding: F2: play_match has no minimum prepaid-gas check. An outsider who attaches just enough gas for play_match + the 40 Tgas on_match callback starves OutLayer, the call fails and the one-shot match is voided (callback_failed). Anyone can void any scheduled match (e.g. all of a rival's matches → rival unranked) for ~0.02 NEAR each. Fix: require!(env::prepaid_gas() >= Gas::from_tgas(250)) (or a computed floor: callback 40 + OutLayer ~150 + own) in play_match.
